A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the most important prognostic factors in metastatic renal cancer include the number of metastatic sites, the presence of bone metastases, and the presence of liver metastases, which should be included in a prognostic model.
the prognosis of patients with bone and liver metastasis from renal cell carcinoma is very poor.
